name: autopilot
description: Project-independent autonomous-dev commands (/autodev, /autoship, /autopilot). Project facts live in a committed .claude/autopilot.config.json (autodetected on first run); browser e2e can be recorded to video. Includes /factory (dispatch tasks to a fabro-based software factory: lanes, gates, monitoring) and /factory-init (scaffold the factory into any repo).
